about: The collecta of the formulary “6th Sunday after Pentecost” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: God of hosts, all that is best belongs to You. Plant love of Your name in our hearts and make our devotion grow, so that You may nourish what is good and, with loving care, preserve what You have nourished. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, forever and ever.

a.g: to whom all that is best belongs
You may nourish what is good
You may guard what has been nourished

ex.w027: In pietatis studio, pietas can denote religious devotion or loving kindness, while studium can denote zeal or attentive care. The request that God nourish and preserve what is good supports “with loving care.” The phrase can also mean “through zealous devotion to God.”
